in_arabic.name: علي
in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic word 'alī' which means 'exalted', 'noble', or 'sublime'. In Islamic tradition, it is a common name for prophets, imams, and leaders due to its noble connotations.

in_urdu.name: علی
in_urdu.long_meaning: This name is transliterated as 'Ali' in Urdu and means 'exalted' or 'noble'.

in_hindi.name: औलय
in_hindi.long_meaning: This name is transliterated as 'Aulay' in Hindi and means 'exalted' or 'elevated'.

in_pashto.name: علي
in_pashto.long_meaning: Although 'Ali' is not a common Pashtun name, it is transliterated in the same way as in Arabic and Urdu. Its meaning in Pashto is 'Shahrzad', the legendary heroine from the One Thousand and One Nights tale.
